subject: Arm Movement and Z-Angle RawData Extraction

messages.author: b1dc8a194d69604b
messages.subject: Arm Movement and Z-Angle RawData Extraction
parts:
Hi,

Thank you for this package and all the hard work! In the part5 visual report, I see that there are the signals (black lines) "arm movement" and "angle of sensor's z−axis relative to horizontal plane". Is there a way to extract the raw results for those as a csv somewhere? I want to be able to plot/manipulate this myself.

Thank you,
Ryan

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Arm Movement and Z-Angle RawData Extraction
parts:
Hi Ryan, 

A combination of "do.anglez=TRUE" and "epochvalues2csv = TRUE" inside the GGIR function will give you a csv in the meta folder with the z angle averaged over whatever you have as the smallest value in the windowsizes call. For example, windowsizes = c(5,900,3600) will give you the z angle in 5s epochs per file. 

You can do the same with do.anglex and do.angley arguments too.

Thanks,
Ben
